t: Green technology and innovation | OECD
s: After continuously increasing since 1990, green innovation as measured by the share of green patents (% of all patented technologies) has decreased since 2010. Many factors can explain this relative decline. Falling fossil fuel prices, a low price on carbon emissions, the maturity of several technologies like solar photovoltaics and the high number of patents in digital technologies are all suspected although no causal evidence has been derived yet.
